name: WASP actin nucleation promoting factor
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: WAS encodes actin nucleation-promoting factor WAS. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase regulator activity and actin binding. It participates in Cdc42 protein signal transduction and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome (x-linked); X-linked severe congenital neutropenia (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
